description: This file defines a singleton class `ImmutableJsonArrayNull` that implements the interfaces `JsonArray` and `JsonNull`, representing an immutable JSON null value wrapped as a JSON array. It provides methods to query and manipulate the JSON array with null semantics, all of which confirm the null state or return empty or default values.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonArrayNull
classes.description: An immutable singleton class representing a JSON null value as an array, implementing JsonArray and JsonNull interfaces.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ImmutableJsonArrayNull.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates that this represents a null value; always returns true.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Indicates that this instance is an array; returns true.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns this instance as a JsonArray.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Methods that would add elements to the array; all return the same singleton instance since it's immutable.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional since null has no elements.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the array contains a given value; always false for null.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns 0 for null; generally indicates not found.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Always returns true for a null array.
